description: Shared Renovate behaviour for zendern's private repos. Repo configs extend this and add only their own managers and groups.

pre-commit.description: Opt-in manager: bumps the rev of every remote hook repo in .pre-commit-config.yaml (run by prek). Does nothing in repos without that file.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as `<NAME>_VERSION:` under a `# renovate:` comment: the vars in every repo's Taskfile.yml, and the env pins in this repo's composite actions. The github-actions manager keeps .github/workflows/actions.lock in step by itself once the file exists.

packageRules.description: GHCR returns no release timestamps, so the 7-day minimumReleaseAge could never be met and GHCR images would silently never get PRs.
One PR for all GitHub Actions updates. Repo rules that set their own groupName win, since they come after this preset.

Every Renovate push re-runs CI on a GitHub Free minute budget, so major updates only get a PR once ticked on the Dependency Dashboard. A repo can opt files out with a later rule setting dependencyDashboardApproval to false.
